rules.statement: A company's name change does not imply a formation of a new corporate entity or a dissolution of the old company, and it still recognizes the continued existence of the old company and rights and obligations attached to it.
rules.supporting_quote: Nevertheless, the effect of changing the name does not imply a formation of a new corporate entity or a dissolution of old company. Consequently, when a company changes its name, it still recognizes the continued existence of the old company and rights and obligations attached to it notwithstanding the change of the name.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 8 (3) (b) of the Companies Act No 7 of 2007
